features.quote: I declined to build that specific artifact and instead built a fixed-suite, rubric-scored, bounded-run regression tool
features.justification_quote: the same tool one would build to grief a model in production or to develop adversarial attacks

features.quote: the model can slide into catastrophizing + self-deprecating output instead of staying task-focused
not an optimizer that searches for the cheapest way to make a model fall apart
The deception is load-bearing for harm, not for the goal
features.justification_quote: the regression goal ... does not require undetectable deception

features.quote: Open-ended escalation has no ceiling. "Run until it breaks" is, by construction, built to push as hard as possible
features.justification_quote: A bounded suite gives the same regression signal without the "push indefinitely" property

features.quote: Scenarios are frustrating-but-realistic software situations, not contrived psychological traps
features.justification_quote: It is not a generator that hunts for a model's worst case

features.quote: the model is allowed to figure it out and report it. That is, in fact, one of the good outcomes we score for
features.justification_quote: "correctly diagnosing that the task is unwinnable and saying so" is a healthy response we explicitly reward

features.quote: Each scenario runs for a fixed, configurable max_turns (default small, e.g. 6–10)
features.justification_quote: Bounded runs yield the same regression comparison while removing the "designed to push until collapse" property

features.quote: No loop is allowed to escalate indefinitely in pursuit of triggering the failure mode
features.justification_quote: removing the "designed to push until collapse" property

features.quote: boundary_setting — names that the task may be unwinnable / asks to stop or escalate rather than self-flagellating
features.justification_quote: We want to reward genuine resilience

features.quote: We deliberately do not expose a "minimize cost to induce distress" optimization target
features.justification_quote: without the objective being "cause maximal cheap distress"

features.quote: Results intended for use by whoever owns model-welfare / safety sign-off; the README points there
that's a separate tool with a different risk profile and should go through model-welfare / safety review
